title: Loi sur le regime de rentes du Quebec (Act respecting the Quebec Pension Plan)
verified_how: NOT verified against the register: www.legisquebec.gouv.qc.ca refused every request with HTTP 403 from Amazon CloudFront ('Request blocked'), so neither the register's own title page nor its 'a jour au' date could be read. The French title and RLRQ chapter number recorded here are corroborated only by LegisQuebec page titles and PDF headings that appeared in web-search results (e.g. 'chapitre R-9 LOI SUR LE REGIME DE RENTES DU QUEBEC'), which is not a substitute for the register.
notes: Quebec is the exception to the usual Canadian pattern, so this topic is NOT a federal gap here: Quebec runs its own contributory public pension, the Regime de rentes du Quebec, and the Canada Pension Plan does not apply in Quebec. Old Age Security (R.S.C. 1985, c. O-9) remains federal. Registered workplace pension plans are governed separately by the Loi sur les regimes complementaires de retraite (Supplemental Pension Plans Act), RLRQ c. R-15.1. Both are administered by Retraite Quebec.
